priorityList: Cast Halo on cooldown to activate Entropic Rift.
Synchronize and cast Power Infusion with Voidform (or Dark Ascension).
Cast Devouring Plague (or Shadow Word: Madness) if you are about to cap Insanity (65+ Insanity) or have a Mind Devourer proc.
Cast Void Blast as your highest priority whenever Entropic Rift is active.
Cast Void Torrent on cooldown, ensuring your DoTs (Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word: Pain) are active.
Cast Tentacle Slam whenever it is available or about to reach maximum charges.
Cast Mind Blast when charges are available and Entropic Rift is not active.
Cast Mind Flay: Insanity whenever the buff is available.
Cast Shadow Word: Death if the target is below 20% health or if the Deathspeaker talent procs.
Maintain Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word: Pain on your primary target.
Cast Shadowfiend (or Mindbender) on cooldown to maximize Insanity generation and Inescapable Torment damage.
Use offensive Trinkets and Potions during your Power Infusion and Voidform window.
Use Mind Flay as a filler spell when no other higher-priority abilities are available.
